technical_and_design_decisions: Preserve the existing project architecture, build system, module conventions, and public APIs wherever possible.
Implement Kafka and Rabbit modules in the s-c-s repository by adapting existing XD implementations rather than redesigning their runtime behavior.
Represent binder selection at channel level using explicit channel-to-binder configuration, while retaining the current binder as the default for backward compatibility.
Use layered external configuration with deterministic precedence: built-in defaults, repository/application configuration, external configuration file, and explicit runtime properties.
Support external overrides for module metadata and Maven coordinates through validated configuration rather than modifying generated or packaged module descriptors.
Refactor the Cloud Foundry deployer SPI to use the existing compatible CF Java client APIs, preserving deployment lifecycle semantics and improving resource handling.
Implement Hadoop distribution selection through a normalized distribution identifier mapped to the corresponding dependency and classpath configuration.
Move header-enricher code into XD proper with compatibility adapters or package changes only where necessary to preserve existing module behavior.
Apply the explicitly requested Spring Integration 4.2, Spring 4.2.1, and AMQP 1.5 dependency upgrades, resolving transitive conflicts without migrating to Spring Framework 6.
Add automated unit, integration, and regression tests for module resolution, binder selection, deployment behavior, Hadoop classpath selection, header enrichment, and dependency compatibility.
assumptions: The existing XD and s-c-s repositories, build files, CI jobs, and relevant source implementations are available and buildable before the increment starts.
The Kafka and Rabbit modules already have substantially complete implementations in XD, so the work is primarily repository migration, integration, configuration adaptation, and testing.
Existing Kafka, Rabbit, Redis, Cloud Foundry, Hadoop, and Maven-related libraries can be used; no new third-party infrastructure or service implementation is required.

The increment is implemented by one software developer, and estimates include implementation, local investigation, automated testing, documentation, and defect correction but exclude elapsed waiting time for external approvals.
No major redesign of the XD runtime, module protocol, deployment model, or packaging format is required beyond the eight stated user stories.
Backward compatibility with existing single-binder configurations and existing module definitions is required unless an incompatibility is imposed by the requested dependency upgrades.
The external configuration file format will use the repository's existing supported configuration mechanism, such as properties or YAML, rather than introducing a new configuration language.

Hadoop distribution support is limited to selecting among distributions that can be represented by dependency and classpath mappings; implementing or packaging Hadoop distributions themselves is out of scope.
The requested dependency versions are the target versions even if they are older than versions mentioned in general Spring documentation.
Release publication, production deployment, and extended soak testing are excluded; CI verification and release-preparation changes are included.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the XD and s-c-s repository structure, existing module implementations, binder abstractions, configuration processing, deployer SPI, dependency management, test conventions, and CI setup. Produce the implementation plan and identify compatibility constraints across all user stories.

Migrate the Kafka module from XD to the s-c-s repository, adapt package and build metadata, wire it into module discovery and packaging, preserve sink behavior, and add or update Kafka-specific unit and integration tests.

Migrate the Rabbit module from XD to the s-c-s repository, adapt package and build metadata, wire it into module discovery and packaging, preserve sink behavior, and add or update Rabbit-specific unit and integration tests.

Extend channel and module configuration models to support different binder types for individual channels, implement binder resolution and lifecycle handling for Rabbit, Redis, and Kafka, retain default-binder behavior, validate invalid configurations, and add compatibility and integration tests.

Add loading, validation, precedence, and merging of external configuration files, including module metadata and Maven-coordinate overrides. Update module resolution and error reporting, and test default, overridden, missing, and invalid configuration cases.

Replace or refactor the existing Cloud Foundry deployer integration around the CF Java client, map existing deployment operations to the new client APIs, improve connection and resource management, preserve status and error semantics, and add unit and integration-level deployer tests.

Define supported Hadoop distribution identifiers, implement configuration and validation, map each selection to the appropriate Hadoop libraries and classpath entries, preserve the current default behavior, and add tests for supported, unsupported, and omitted selections.

Move the header-enricher implementation and associated metadata from the modules repository into XD proper, update packaging and registration, preserve configuration and runtime behavior, and migrate or recreate its tests.

activities.activity_name: Upgrade Spring Integration, Spring, and AMQP dependencies
activities.activity_description: Update dependency declarations to Spring Integration 4.2, Spring 4.2.1, and AMQP 1.5, resolve transitive dependency conflicts, adjust source code for API changes, and run focused regression tests across affected modules.

Create end-to-end and regression coverage combining migrated modules, per-channel binders, external overrides, Hadoop selection, deployer changes, header-enricher behavior, and upgraded dependencies. Include build verification and compatibility checks for existing use cases.

Document new binder configuration, external override files, Maven-coordinate overrides, Hadoop distribution selection, migrated module usage, dependency changes, compatibility notes, and representative configuration examples.

activities.activity_name: Build, CI, packaging, and release preparation
activities.activity_description: Update build descriptors, dependency management, module manifests, generated metadata, CI jobs, packaging rules, and static checks. Verify clean builds and test execution in supported environments and prepare the increment for review or release.

activities.activity_name: Final defect correction and acceptance verification
activities.activity_description: Perform final code review and acceptance walkthrough against U1-U8, correct defects found during integration, verify backward compatibility and error handling, and complete the final test run.
